title: Narrative updated
text: The project moved from a visual redesign into a versioned storefront system. The current phase expands the full mode with original brand content, social/support links, new-product merchandising and a validated delivery/payment checkout while preserving the one-page experience and strict source-integrity boundaries.

title: ANESTET v11.0.1 production release
text: The source-faithful full storefront and preserved one-page view were released with a durable checkout/order API. Production QA order AN-20260828-10DD41 proved price recomputation and storage. Original connector code was preserved; absent secrets were not fabricated or exposed. GitHub CI passed on final metadata commit f85c9af2.

title: ANESTET v11.0.1 production checkpoint
text: GitHub releases and VPS deployment complete with source-faithful content, original fonts, official channels, checkout, protected order storage and explicit credential boundary.

title: Полная сверка правок, все новинки в hero и дефект поддержки
Пропорции каталога и безопасная зона плашек
New storefront is autonomous from legacy shop
text: All legacy-site customer journeys are migrated into the new ANESTET interface; the new site never links visitors to the old store.
rationale: Preserves one coherent purchase journey, prevents broken/stylistically inconsistent handoffs, and allows backend integrations to be replaced behind the new UI without changing customer navigation.

title: Restore three-way site comparison switcher
text: Replace the top Information shortcut with a direct old-site comparison button so the three controls compare old, one-page and full-site variants.

title: Allow legacy site only as an explicit comparison target
text: The top site-version switcher contains exactly three choices: Старый сайт, Одностраничный, Полный сайт. Старый сайт opens qkcosmetic.ru in a new tab. No other customer journey in the new storefront may hand off to the legacy store.
rationale: The user needs a deliberate side-by-side comparison of the historical, one-page and full variants while preserving the autonomous new-site purchase flow.

title: Правки правок и отсутствие границы Opaline
text: Пользователь требует сохранять цепочку правок и применять последнюю уточнённую версию. Opaline и ореол должны уходить влево и растворяться без видимой границы.
